clock_domains.required_physical: Streaming 1.2GHz, serial 0.9GHz. No separate 0.9GHz clock/reset/CDC port exists in this fixture. Two streaming FFs cannot alone release a physical serial domain.
clock_domains.serial_release: Parent must provide distinct serial-domain release and readiness join; its hardware cost is not included in 0.84564um2.
clock_domains.source_die: clk plus core.g_me_cg.u_me_cg.u_icg gated me_clk; enable forced by !rst_n; CXX tiles receive direct clk.
clock_domains.source_tile: All tile registers clocked by clk; same 1.2GHz streaming proposal.

conditional_external_release_window.scope: Conservative external-root pin requirement across Liberty grids, before wire/skew. Both root FFs must meet it. This is not an observed provider phase, internal closure, or recovery/removal waiver.

die_bench_hardware.scope: Complete elaborated hierarchy, proc only; no opt/map/CTS. Register WIDTH is a source load inventory, not mapped pins.

price.corridor_note: One local root/tile; existing shared reset/clk still require fanout routing. Zero new global signals does not establish routing fit.
price.global_reset_fanout_note: 3072 root RESETN pins/die plus separate die/core branch; do not drive them with one assumed ideal source.
price.memory_clock_note: 10 ROM and 2 KV physical macro CLK ports added to logic-only inventory; macros themselves are not reset.
price.source_census_note: Pre-opt proc WIDTH totals, not mapped pin survival. Core includes bench/sequencer, spine and SU; hosted tile fabric added exactly once.

ff.note: Pin-only nominal inputs. Wire, CTS and all other tile reset loads require the actual mapped parent.

ss.note: Pin-only nominal inputs. Wire, CTS and all other tile reset loads require the actual mapped parent.

protocol.acceptance: Release after edge 2; first downstream acceptance edge 3. IREG captures ib/x/go then; engine accepts at edge 4; first ROM producer re/address after edge 5; macro accepts edge 6; MEM_EXTRA capture edge 7.
protocol.assertion: Asynchronous low assertion, no ROM ECC added; reset valid/control, not ROM payload.
protocol.bench: rt_rst_n NBA at cyc5. Synchronizer stages sample at cyc6/7; downstream reset available at cyc8. Bench start NBA at cyc7 is first sampled at cyc8. This is a source schedule, not a physical inputdelay.
protocol.queue: Tile ready()/idle() are unconnected. No ready handshake or request queue exists at ib_go. Parent must hold/schedule ib_go and ib/x through first acceptance; never silently add a queue.
protocol.release: Two same-streaming-clock DFFASR/QN plus two INV. External RESETN on both; SETN tied high. No arbitrary-phase recovery/removal waiver.
protocol.scope: Per-tile producer resets complete tile control. Die/core remain a distinct upstream reset branch. A global owner must coordinate starts and streaming/serial readiness.

ranked_release_dependencies.missing: Physical external RESETN min/max phase, pulse width, recovery/removal at both root FFs; coordinated streaming/serial reset and start contract.
Mapped complete-tile clock/reset pin classes and loads, full reset distribution, CTS slew/skew, source address/strobe CLKQ SS/FF. Source register census below is complete for the explicit fixture.
Incremental reset/clock tree cells and wire, pin/OBS/PG slot placement and routing-layer/corridor capacity receipt.
Only after 1-3 compose: actual two-FF/INV path FF hold, SS setup, recovery/removal, macro capture, pulse width, complete tile SS/FF. No input-zero-delay failure relabeling.

release_equations.no_waivers: Apply at both external rootFF RESETN pins, every tile reset pin and every active macro capture endpoint. Grid envelopes do not establish slew or arrival bounds.
release_equations.tile_recovery: Tstream - root_stage2_CLKQ_max - INV_max - reset_distribution_max - skew_max >= SS recovery +60ps
release_equations.tile_removal: root_stage2_CLKQ_min + INV_min + reset_distribution_min - downstream_CLK_skew_max >= FF removal +25ps

source_ports.note: 64 MAC/cycle describes existing W16/TG4 tile; reset block performs zero MACs and zero memory transfers.
source_ports.producer: u_me.g_issue_fast: registered wrom_re, wrom_addr<=cur; address has no reset assignment and is qualified only by accepted CE.

sourcepins.parameter_scope: Die non-overridden parameters are actual fixture defaults. This observed bench hardware is not a physical W12 wire-stage admission; parent final instantiated parameters require a new additive census if different.
sourcepins.source_derivations: census_ snapshots only prepend timescale and remove unused fulltile wrapper; r4 adds per-module timescale. Successful authoritative census uses unmodified sources plus immutable parent candidate snapshots, Yosys0.68 hierarchy+proc only. BUF/ICG blackboxes enumerate known instance ports, give no timing/area/load credit.

tile.scope: Complete elaborated hierarchy, proc only; no opt/map/CTS. Register WIDTH is a source load inventory, not mapped pins.
